description: Compile and run a Lobster program with the locally installed toolchain. Writes the code to a temporary directory, runs `lobster main.lobster` there, and returns the exit code, stdout and stderr. Requires Lobster to be installed on the machine (see toolchain_status). Times out after 10s by default and the reference data never leaves the machine.

args.description: Arguments passed to the program after `--` (Lobster exposes them via command_line_arguments()).

code.description: Complete Lobster source code to compile and run.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the process after this many milliseconds. Default 10000, max 60000.

name: run_code
